review_candidates.title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all. About the Role: Our Infrastructure Services team is responsible for ensuring that the infrastructure backing all production services is highly available, scalable, and operating optimally. The Principal Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical leader who operates across both network and systems engineering, driving architecture, reliability, and automation. This role requires someone who can lead at a strategic level, collaborate across teams, and dive deep technically to solve complex problems in production environments. What You’ll Do: Design, build, and evolve infrastructure supporting production services across network and systems domains, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability Drive improvements to reliability, redundancy, and overall service delivery across infrastructure environments Serve as a senior escalation point for complex production issues, troubleshooting and resolving critical incidents impacting service availability Lead by example through hands-on technical contribution and ownership of challenging infrastructure problems Oversee and optimize on-premises network infrastructure, including switching, routing, firewalls, and load balancing, while ensuring security and resilience Architect and manage Linux systems, virtualization platforms, and server infrastructure to support stable, high-performing environments Lead the development and adoption of automation across network and systems environments, implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to standardize operations Reduce manual processes and improve consistency across deployments and operational workflows Partner with Engineering, Development, QA, and Application teams to support services and align infrastructure with business and application requirements Act as a technical bridge to drive successful delivery of cross-functional initiatives Establish and enforce infrastructure best practices and standards while mentoring team members and elevating overall technical capability Drive continuous improvement across infrastructure design, operations, and documentation Evaluate, design, and implement AI-assisted tooling to improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency Foster the development, implementation, and progression of AI-based tools and software to streamline infrastructural tasks and expedite completion of projects and initiatives. Experience We’re Looking For: 12+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, including deep expertise in network engineering (routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing) and systems engineering (Linux, virtualization, server hardware), along with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience may be considered) Proven experience supporting production environments in on-premises datacenters, with a strong focus on reliability and operational stability Strong hands-on expertise in Linux administration and performance optimization across complex environments Solid understanding of core networking protocols and platforms, including BGP, OSPF, TCP/IP, Juniper Junos, and Arista EOS, is essential Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues across the full infrastructure stack, from hardware through network and systems layers Experience implementing automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar is required Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, or equivalent) to support automation and operational efficiency Familiarity with network and systems automation frameworks and modern infrastructure practices Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, with a track record of owning and delivering large-scale infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced environments Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker is strongly preferred Familiarity with hybrid or cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) would be valuable Exposure to monitoring, observability, and capacity planning tools and practices is a plus Background in high availability, disaster recovery, and failover design is considered an advantage What We Offer: Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And, you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks. Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and eligible dependents HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund) Employer Paid Income Protection Benefits (Basic Life and AD&D, Short- and Long-term disability) FSA Healthcare & Dependent Care Commuter Benefits Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Legal 401(k), including employer match, and Roth Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Paid Time off, Sick Time, as well as corporate holidays observed Employee Assistance Program Life Balance benefits with Travel Assistance Services and Identity Theft Additional Benefits include a Discount Program, Credit Union, Medicare Assistance, etc. Ooma is an equal-opportunity employer committed to recruiting, employing, retaining, promoting, and otherwise treating all employees on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. These tools are used solely to support our hiring team; all employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Where interviews are recorded or transcribed, candidates will be notified in advance and their consent will be obtained. The base salary range for candidates within the United States is listed below. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, specific location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Regular employees may also be eligible for bonus(es), sales incentive(s) (target included in OTE) and/or stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). review_candidates.title: Senior Engineer, Applications Systems
review_candidates.description: Technology Services team is integral to maintaining the Firm’s overall technology, mobile and desktop devices, and core infrastructure to ensure reliable, secure and efficient operations. Technology Services is a single global operation with representation in each of the Firm’s offices. Additionally, we have shared service centers in Tampa and Manila, supporting a wide range of technologies and operations. In addition to overseeing critical enterprise systems and providing world-class client service to our global user community, we are committed to achieving a balance between new and innovative technologies while constantly ensuring data security and compliance with legal and regulatory standards, resulting in realizing value from the latest developments in technology, such as generative artificial intelligence and cloud computing models, while safeguarding sensitive client information against cyber threats and other business interruption events. Technology Services plays a significant role in supporting the Firm’s systems and people. Position Summary The Senior Engineer, Applications Systems is a self-starting problem solver responsible for designing, building, administering and supporting enterprise systems and applications across global environments. This role requires the ability to work independently with minimal direction and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams, providing technical leadership and hands-on execution. Duties And Accountabilities The roles and responsibilities of this job include: Design, build, administer and optimize Windows Server environments including installation, configuration, patching, performance tuning and troubleshooting. Design, build, administer and optimize Linux environments (e.g. RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu or similar) including scripting for automation, configuration management and system monitoring. Manage and support database platforms including SQL Server, MongoDB and PostgreSQL, covering installation, configuration, performance tuning, backup/restore and high availability solutions. Own application deployment and lifecycle management for enterprise applications, including packaging, configuration, environment management, monitoring and incident resolution. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, including build and release definitions, infrastructure as code, automated testing and deployment workflows. Configure, support and troubleshoot cloud technologies and applications (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP), including resource provisioning, networking, identity, monitoring and cost optimization. Apply a strong understanding of AI concepts, purposes and uses, as well as common pitfalls and risks (e.g. bias, data privacy, hallucinations), to support integration of AI-enabled solutions and guide stakeholders. Develop and support integration solutions for cloud and on-premise systems using technologies such as Python, Integration Builder and Boomi, including API design, data transformation and error handling. Design, configure and support computer networks, including core networking terminology and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing) and related troubleshooting. Implement and support enterprise security mechanisms including Akamai, CyberArk and CrowdStrike, ensuring secure configurations, policy adherence, monitoring and incident response in collaboration with security teams. Provide enterprise-level support for a global organization, including participation in an on-call rotation, handling escalated incidents, root cause analysis and driving continuous improvement. Create and maintain technical documentation, standards and runbooks for systems, integrations and deployments. Collaborate with architects, developers, security, networking and operations teams to design resilient, secure and scalable solutions. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing across teams. Qualifications The qualifications for this role are: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Extensive hands-on experience as a systems engineer or similar role with responsibility across Windows and Linux server environments. Proven experience with: Windows Server administration and build activities Linux administration and build activities Database technologies: SQL Server, MongoDB and PostgreSQL Application deployment and environment management in enterprise settings CI/CD practices and tools, specifically Azure DevOps Cloud technologies and applications, including configuration, support and troubleshooting Python for scripting and integration, plus experience with Integration Builder and Boomi or similar iPaaS tools Computer networking fundamentals and configuration Enterprise security tools such as Akamai, CyberArk and CrowdStrike Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both independent and team-based settings, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner. Experience supporting global organizations, including working across time zones, cultures and regulatory environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with infrastructure as code tools (e.g. ARM templates, Terraform or similar). Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes). Exposure to AI platforms or services (e.g. Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML, Google AI) and practical understanding of governance, risk and compliance considerations around AI use. Relevant industry certifications (e.g. Microsoft, Linux, cloud provider, security). Key Competencies Self-starter mindset with strong ownership and accountability. Collaborative team player able to build effective relationships with technical and business stakeholders. Structured and detail-oriented approach to documentation, change management and configuration management. Continuous learner, staying abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in systems engineering, cloud, security and AI. Salary Range The New York salary range for this role is $133,600 - 200,400 This role reports to Senior Manager, Applications Engineering Equal Opportunities White & Case is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and is committed to creating a fair workplace. It is our Firm’s policy to recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected by applicable law. Applicants who are interested in applying for a position and require an accommodation during the process should contact talent.acquisition@whitecase.com. Benefits At White & Case White & Case LLP offers a comprehensive suite of benefit programs to all eligible employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, 401(k) retirement savings, vacation time, and leave programs (including parental leave). Exempt roles are also performance bonus eligible. The Firm may modify and amend any job description at any time in its sole discretion. Nothing herein creates a contract of employment or otherwise modifies the at-will nature of employment. The above is only a general description of the essential duties associated with this position and does not represent an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all duties. Note to Recruitment Agencies Our internal Recruitment team manages all aspects of lateral hiring. All agencies must have signed terms of business—specific to the relevant office—before submitting any candidates. CVs or applications sent directly to White & Case partners or employees will also not be considered formal introductions. If you have questions, please contact the relevant Recruitment team. We work with our preferred suppliers when engaging agencies.

review_candidates.description: 【Position 1】 Bilingual Project Manager (PM) / PMO – Japanese & English Position Overview We are seeking a bilingual Project Manager / PMO in Tokyo to serve as a bridge between Japanese and international stakeholders. You will manage IT projects involving teams in Japan, the U.S., Asia, and other regions, covering project planning, schedule and progress management, issue and risk management, meeting facilitation, documentation, and reporting. This is not simply a translation or interpretation role. We are looking for someone who can understand both business and cultural differences and proactively drive projects forward in a global environment. Key Responsibilities • Manage domestic and international IT projects, including schedule, progress, quality, and cost • Coordinate between Japanese stakeholders and overseas teams • Facilitate meetings in Japanese and English • Prepare project documentation, reports, and meeting minutes • Manage issues, risks, and escalations • Coordinate vendors and cross-functional stakeholders • Support projects as a PMO or lead projects as a PM Requirements • 4–5+ years of PM or PMO experience in IT projects • Business-level Japanese and English • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders • Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, system development, or digital projects • Eligible to work in Japan (visa support may be discussed if needed) Preferred • Global or cross-border project experience • Experience working with multinational organizations or overseas offices • PMP or similar certification • Understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies Location: Tokyo Duration: 6 months–1 year, with possible extension Annual Salary: JPY 12,000,000 Working Hours: 9:00–17:00, excluding lunch; overtime compensated separately ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【Position 2】 SAP S/4HANA Project Manager – Manufacturing Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead an SAP S/4HANA implementation and business transformation project involving multiple manufacturing operations in Japan. Key Responsibilities • Lead the overall SAP S/4HANA implementation project • Manage multiple manufacturing sites and SAP workstreams • Manage budget, resources, critical path, and dependencies • Manage project issues, risks, and escalations • Report to Steering Committees and Executive Sponsors • Coordinate Business, Local IT, Global IT, and System Integrators • Manage scope and control unnecessary SAP customization • Lead Integration Testing, Cutover, Go-Live, and Hypercare • Support Change Management, Training, and User Adoption • Drive phased SAP rollouts across multiple locations Requirements • 10+ years of IT Project / Program Management experience • Experience as a Project Manager or Delivery Lead on SAP S/4HANA implementations • SAP implementation experience in Manufacturing or Supply Chain • Experience managing multiple SAP workstreams and locations • Experience with Scope, Budget, Resource, Risk, and Dependency Management • Experience communicating with Steering Committees and Executive Sponsors • Experience leading Cutover and Hypercare • Working knowledge of SAP Activate • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification • Business-level or higher Japanese and English Preferred • SAP project experience with Japanese manufacturing companies • Global SAP Template rollout experience • Batch / Lot Management and Traceability experience • Knowledge of SAP Digital Manufacturing • Knowledge of SAP BTP / Clean Core Governance • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud • Discrete Manufacturing experience such as Electronics, Automotive, or Precision Components Location: Tokyo Annual Salary: JPY 12,000,000 On-site work at manufacturing locations in Japan may be required depending on the project phase. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【Position 3】 IT Engineer Position Overview We are looking for an IT Engineer in Tokyo to support the setup, operation, and maintenance of client IT environments. Responsibilities include network and hardware support, system troubleshooting, maintenance, and coordination with stakeholders in Japan and the U.S. Experienced engineers are welcome, but candidates who are new to IT and motivated to develop their careers as IT Engineers or Support Desk professionals may also apply. Requirements • Experience in IT system setup, operation, or maintenance, OR strong motivation to start a career in IT • JLPT N1 or N2 • Experience or interest in IT infrastructure • Good communication skills • Eligible to work in Japan (visa support may be discussed if needed) Location: Tokyo Duration: 6 months–1 year, with possible extension Annual Salary: JPY 10,000,000+ Working Hours: 9:00–17:00, excluding lunch; overtime compensated separately ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 【Position 4】 Bilingual IT Engineer – Japanese & English Position Overview We are seeking a bilingual IT Engineer with approximately 2–4 years of IT experience to support day-to-day IT operations and users in a global business environment. You will provide technical support for PCs, Microsoft 365, networks, user accounts, and other IT systems while communicating with Japanese and English-speaking users and IT teams. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career IT professional who wants to further develop technical skills in an international environment. Key Responsibilities • Provide end-user IT support and troubleshooting • Support Windows PCs, laptops, printers, and other devices • Support Microsoft 365 applications and user accounts • Handle account setup, access permissions, password resets, and onboarding/offboarding • Troubleshoot network, Wi-Fi, VPN, and connectivity issues • Install and configure PCs, software, and peripherals • Coordinate with internal IT teams and external vendors • Communicate with users and IT teams in Japanese and English • Maintain IT documentation and asset information Requirements • Approximately 2–4 years of professional IT experience • Experience in IT Support, Helpdesk, Desktop Support, IT Infrastructure, or similar roles • Basic knowledge of Windows, networks, and IT infrastructure • Microsoft 365 support experience • Basic hardware, software, and network troubleshooting skills • Business-level Japanese and English • Strong communication and customer support skills • Eligible to work in Japan Preferred • Experience in a bilingual or international environment • Microsoft 365 administration experience • Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID experience • Basic knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and Wi-Fi • PC deployment and IT asset management experience • Experience coordinating with overseas IT teams or vendors Location: Tokyo Annual Salary: JPY 4,000,000–6,000,000

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Cloud Engineering and Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: We Make Life More Rewarding and Dignified Location : Libertyville Department : Information Technology Summary The Senior Manager, Cloud Engineering and Infrastructure leads the strategy, engineering standards, and operational excellence for global hybrid infrastructure across data centers, co-location environments, cloud platforms, and related enterprise services. This role manages a global engineering team accountable for reliability, scalability, performance, security, resilience, and cost effectiveness in support of manufacturing, R&D, commercial, and corporate operations. Hollister operates in a hybrid work environment. Associates are requirements are required to be onsite a minimum of 4 days per week. Responsibilities Lead and develop a global Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering team; establish operating models, engineering standards, documentation, escalation paths, and performance expectations for 24x7x365 support. Own strategy, architecture alignment, lifecycle management, and modernization for compute, virtualization, storage/backup, Azure, data center, Microsoft 365 dependencies, and related hybrid platforms. Drive platform reliability through SLAs/SLOs, KPI reporting, observability, capacity/performance management, patching, backup, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance. Lead major incident response and problem management; ensure effective triage, communications, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident learning. Advance automation, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and repeatable deployment patterns to improve delivery speed, consistency, and operational efficiency. Partner with Cybersecurity to maintain secure-by-design infrastructure, hardening standards, access controls, vulnerability management, audit readiness, and compliant operations. Own disaster recovery and resiliency planning for critical platforms, including runbooks, testing, RTO/RPO reporting, and remediation plans. Manage strategic vendors, budgets, demand forecasts, cloud/infrastructure cost optimization, and executive communication of platform health, risks, roadmaps, and trade-offs. Communicate effectively with associates, leaders, and suppliers regarding infrastructure performance, incidents, risks, and priorities. Participate in incident response, problem management, escalation calls, and after-hours support as needed. Review technical documentation, vendor materials, and industry updates to remain current on infrastructure practices. Travel by plane or automobile as required, typically 10% or less. Essential Functions Of The Role Vision-setting and alignment with business strategy. High-level decision-making and resource allocation. Oversight of compliance, risk, and organizational culture. Communicate effectively via email, phone, and virtual platforms. Collaborate across departments to support organizational goals. Serve as a point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Maintain and analyze data using tools like Excel, SAP, or HRIS systems. Prepare reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders. Demonstrate initiative in identifying process improvements or automation opportunities. Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Education & Work Requirements Bachelor’s Degree with 12-15 years of related experience Education & Work Preferences Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 12 years of progressive IT experience, including 8+ years supporting enterprise hybrid infrastructure and cloud platforms in a 24x7 environment. Minimum 7 years leading engineering and/or infrastructure operations teams with accountability for production services, controls, metrics, and continuous improvement. Experience operating at enterprise scale, including vendor management, budgeting/forecasting, executive reporting, and cross-functional leadership with cybersecurity, architecture, and application teams. Fluency in English is required. Senior engineering leadership with demonstrated success improving reliability, operational maturity, KPIs/SLOs/SLAs, and team performance. Strong hybrid infrastructure expertise across Windows and/or Linux, virtualization, storage/backup, data centers, Azure, Microsoft 365 dependencies, networking integration, identity/RBAC, monitoring, and cost management. Proven mastery of ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management, including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident learning. Experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep/ARM, PowerShell, source control, configuration management, and repeatable deployment patterns. Strong observability and reliability engineering mindset, including monitoring/logging strategy, dashboards, capacity/performance management, and service readiness reviews. Demonstrated partnership with Cybersecurity on hardening, vulnerability management, secure operations, audit readiness, and disaster recovery/resiliency planning. Executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate risks, trade-offs, priorities, and business impact clearly. Competencies Be Agile - Innovates and adapts quickly, approaching change with curiosity while persisting through obstacles. Be Customer Centric - Considers the needs, experiences and feedback of customers in all we do. Be People-Focused - Builds trust and collaborates with an inclusive and empathetic approach. Be Performance Driven - Operates with an ownership mindset, driving meaningful outcomes. Live The Schneiders’ Legacy, Our Noble Purpose - Passionately serves Our Mission and Vision, while demonstrating the Immutable Principles. Our Total Rewards package in aggregate is above market and includes competitive pay, paid time off programs, peer-to-peer recognition, health and life insurance, wellness programs and incentives, and generous retirement savings. The anticipated base pay range for this position is $190,000 - $215,000 yearly. The actual salary varies based on applicant's location, education, experience, skills, abilities, and other legitimate business factors. This position is also eligible to participate in the Hollister Corporate Bonus Plan. The Company’s health and welfare benefits include medical, prescription, dental, vision, spending/savings accounts, disability, company paid (parental and caregiver) leaves, statutory leaves/disability programs, accident, life, wellbeing, education assistance, adoption assistance, and voluntary benefit programs. The Company’s 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan includes: auto-enrollment, ROTH, vesting and eligible participants “safe harbor” matching contributions. The Company’s paid time off benefits include: 11 paid holidays, paid vacation based on length of service and exempt/non-exempt status, and sick days based on statutory requirements and/or exempt/non-exempt status. The Company’s additional benefits include: education assistance and adoption assistance benefit programs. About Hollister Incorporated Hollister Incorporated is an independent, employee-owned company that develops, manufactures and markets healthcare products worldwide. The company spearheads the advancement of innovative products for ostomy care, continence care and critical care, and also creates educational support materials for patients and healthcare professionals. Headquartered in Libertyville, Illinois, Hollister has manufacturing and distribution centers on three continents and sells in nearly 80 countries. Hollister is a wholly owned subsidiary of The Firm of John Dickinson Schneider, Inc., and is guided both by its Mission to make life more rewarding and dignified for people who use our products and services, as well as its Vision to grow and prosper as an independent, employee-owned company, and in the process, to become better human beings. EOE Statement All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. review_candidates.title: Content manager
review_candidates.description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Campaign management. Own acquisition campaigns end to end—from hypothesis to launch to iteration—running structured data-driven retrospectives to extract learnings and translating them into new creative solutions. Find technical optimizations and raise the bar with each cycle of iteration. Content creation. Leverage AI tools to produce high-performing, cross-channel visual content, directing hand-picked creators and writing tailored briefs to deliver the right message to each audience. Cross-functional coordination. Connect creative, marketing, and business stakeholders, managing timelines and priorities to ensure every campaign is delivered smoothly and effectively. Trend monitoring. Track social media trends, competitor activity, and emerging creative practices to inform future campaign and content decisions. Management of advertising. Manage advertising partnerships by building strong relationships with clients or external partners, coordinating campaign execution, and ensuring high-quality delivery across all collaborations. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £47,660 to £68,579 in London and from €46,027 to €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £151,436 in London or €145,430 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Working closely with both UK and French engineering teams, you will provide in-house technical expertise throughout the development and pre-construction phases of renewable energy projects. This hands-on role focuses on access design and transport feasibility, civil pre-design, CAD production and spatial data management, while contributing to the delivery of safe, efficient and cost-effective project solutions. ⚡ You Will Play An Important Role In Designing and assessing access routes, transport studies and abnormal load feasibility for wind, solar and energy storage projects in the UK and France. Supporting the preliminary civil design of roads, platforms, crane pads, site infrastructure and earthworks, while integrating constructability and cost considerations. Producing and maintaining high-quality CAD drawings for development studies, permitting applications and pre-construction activities, while supporting the management of spatial project data. Providing technical support to development, engineering and construction teams through site visits, consultant coordination and the identification of access, civil and development constraints. 💡 To Succeed In This Position, You Need A degree in Civil Engineering, Infrastructure Design or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, combined with proven experience in road, access and civil infrastructure design. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD and experience with civil engineering design software such as Civil 3D, Covadis or equivalent tools. Solid knowledge of access road design, earthworks, site layouts, abnormal load transport requirements and the integration of environmental, hydrological and geotechnical constraints. Strong collaboration, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and external consultants in a renewable energy development environment. 🌍Together, we will build a sustainable and inclusive world: By joining our team, you will contribute to the growth of a company committed to the energy transition. Boralex promotes a culture of sustainable performance, aligned with its business objectives. We focus on long-term growth and profitabilitywhile aiming for the satisfaction of all our stakeholders. Continuous improvementis essential, with ambitious and measurable goals, and this culture is fostered by autonomy, the right to make mistakes, and employee empowerment. Transparency, inclusion, and kindnessare essential elements in creating a rewarding work environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves. This is why we raise awareness among all our teams on these issues and offer support networks, best practices, and educational content. We value the diversity of experiences, perspectives, and expressionsamong our colleagues, partners, and communities. Feel free to join us, regardless of your age, origin, gender, potential disability, sexual orientation, or beliefs. 🌱To Be Fully Fulfilled In Your Daily Life By joining our team, a growing leader in the renewable energy sector, you will benefit from a public transport allowance up to £100/month, a wellbeing bonus, and the possibility of hybrid working. Boralex, beyond renewable energies !

review_candidates.title: Building Services Manager
review_candidates.description: Heritage is for everybody, and we are here for heritage.Heritage lives in places and people, memories and stories, artefacts and traditions. It can connect us all to the past, and to each other. It can make us happier, strengthen every community, and help shape society for the better. Everybody should be able to enjoy the benefits it brings.That's why, as a charity, we care for over a million objects and hundreds of historic sites in every part of England, from international icons to local treasures. And it's why we open them up, share their stories and find new ways for everybody to enjoy, learn, play and create.We are looking for a Building Services Manager to join our team. The role is full time, permanent and working 36 hours per week.We offer flexible working arrangements where the role allows. This role covers Kent and East Sussex and is based at our Dover Castle office or homebased.The Benefits- Salary from £40,852, depending on skills, experience and location- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, pro rata, rising to 28 days after 3 years- Matched pension contributions up to 10%- Flexible hours- The opportunity to progress your career within the heritage sector- Apprenticeship opportunities- Subscriptions to professional bodies- Free access to all English Heritage sites for you and up to six friends and family members- 25% discount in our shops and cafes- Enhanced maternity, paternity or shared parental leave- Options to buy additional leave- An inclusive working atmosphere everybody is supported from all backgrounds, religions and with different needs- Opportunities to go to some of our great live music and history eventsEnglish Heritage cares for the monuments, buildings and places that bring the story of England to life for over 10 million visitors each year.This is a great opportunity for a dedicated Mechanical and Electrical professional to join the South and East Team as a Building Services Manager supporting our Kent and Sussex portfolio which includes Dover Castle, Walmer Castle, Deal Castle and Battle Abbey. This role brings together building services, facilities and project management providing expertise to a team that delivers a holistic estates service to the region.You will actively champion Building Services and lead on the maintenance and management of Mechanical and Electrical systems across the region. The sites within the portfolio vary considerably in complexity and scale. Ranging from Castle's such as Dover, Walmer and Deal to Roman Forts such as Richborough.Are you passionate about caring for some of England's most important historical buildings and landmarks? If so, this is a great opportunity to join English Heritage Trust's Kent and Sussex based Estates Management team. The Building Services Manager's primary purpose is to provide a high-quality building services maintenance provision and associated facilities management support for the National Collection of Historic Properties and Estates. It is a busy and varied role which makes the everyday interesting with no two days the same.The Estates Department is made up of four Regions with teams providing professional expertise to conserve and maintain a range of properties from country houses, ruined castles to hill forts and Roman temples. Working from either Dover Castle or remotely from home, you will be part of the South & East Region team, supporting a diverse portfolio of historic sites across Kent and Sussex.As Building Services Manager, you will manage mechanical and electrical assets across historic properties and modern visitor facilities. Working with Estate Managers, the Senior Estate Manager, site colleagues and the Facilities Manager, you will use condition information to prioritise maintenance and plan the timely replacement of end-of-life infrastructure, keeping services safe, compliant and reliable.To do this the role requires strong project/contract management skills and a working understanding of health and safety regulations in a construction environment (CDM Regulations etc.). It also requires competence in operating within the constraints of heritage and planning policies and statutory requirements, as well as being able to demonstrate a robust understanding of historic building conservation best practice principles.As a confident communicator, you will work collaboratively with Estate Managers, the Senior Estates Manager and site colleagues across the Kent and Sussex portfolio, including the Facilities Manager for the Kent area based at Dover Castle. You will build strong working relationships to coordinate maintenance, projects and day-to-day building services priorities.You will have experience of working with both internal stakeholders and managing contractors in procuring, administering and supervising M&E measured term contracts and associated budgets. You will be confident in preparing works instructions and managing and auditing the quality of work on site.You will also ensure that asset information, maintenance schedules, service records and statutory certification are accurately recorded and kept up to date in the K2 CAFM system, in line with statutory compliance requirements and English Heritage Safety Critical Reporting standards.To be considered as a Building Services Manager, you'll need:1. Minimum HNC/HND level qualification in mechanical and /or electrical engineering and/or equivalent relevant experience in Building/Construction.2. Experience of client-side administration of M&E term maintenance contracts and schedules of rates including budget control and management of KPIs.3. Experience of developing and delivering small to medium M&E capital projects such as boiler and lift replacement.4. Ability to prepare schedules of work, specifications, simple working drawings and diagrams.5. Working knowledge of current legislation and regulations covering an extensive range of mechanical and electrical systems, including fire safety/firefighting equipment, gas safety, pressure systems, legionella controls, security systems and works and other relevant statutory regulations and bylawsInterviews will be held on 22nd October 2026 at Dover Castle.If you would like to talk to us e.g. about workplace adjustments or working patterns, please contact Karen Eakers, Estates Manager on karen.eakers@english-heritage.org.uk. No agencies please.Find out more about us and what we do: https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/about/ You can also meet some of our people and hear about why they enjoy working with us: https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/about/our-people/careers-with-us/Everybody's welcome at English HeritageForget the stereotypes. It takes thousands of people from every background to care for England's heritage and open it up for everybody to enjoy. We're looking for every type of person with every kind of skill and experience, and we're committed to making sure that English Heritage is an equitable, diverse and inclusive place to work. You can connect with others through our EDI networks as a member or ally. These include Ethnic Diversity, Faith & Belief, Social Equity, LGBTQ+, Neurodivergence, Age, Disability and Gender Health and Wellbeing.We take wellbeing seriously. We are committed to ensuring everyone feels safe at work and can carry out their role. To support this, we have a network of Mental Health First aiders, regular information and awareness events, unlimited access to an Employee Assistance Programme and work with our people to implement reasonable adjustments. Closing date: 04/10/2026 23:59:59

review_candidates.title: Associate Medical Director, Nephrology
review_candidates.description: Job Overview The Associate Medical Director will provide medical, clinical and scientific advisory expertise to all IQVIA divisions as requested. Participate in all aspects of Medical Science involvement on assigned trials. Serve as a medical expert during project delivery lifecycle. Provide therapeutic and medical expertise to business development activities. Essential Functions Medical Monitoring: Primarily serves as Global Medical Advisor on assigned projects. Serves as Scientific Advisor and provides guidance to Project Leaders on the medical and scientific aspects of assigned projects. Provides medical support to investigative sites and project staff for protocol-related issues including protocol clarifications, inclusion/exclusion determinations, and issues of patient safety and/or eligibility. Performs medical review of the protocol, Investigative Drug Brochure (IDB), and/or Case Report Forms (CRFs). Provides therapeutic area/indication training for the project clinical team. Attends and presents at Investigator Meetings. Performs review and clarification of trial-related Adverse Events (AEs). May perform medical case review of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), including review of case documentation and patient narrative, in collaboration with the Pharmacovigilance department. May provide medical support for the Analysis of Similar Events (AOSE), in collaboration with or on behalf of Pharmacovigilance department. May perform medical review of adverse event coding. Performs review of the Clinical Study Report (CSR) and patient narratives. Attends Kick-Off meetings, weekly team meetings, and client meetings, as needed or requested. Available 24/7 to respond urgent protocol -related questions from investigative sites, in accordance with local labor laws. May require regular travel (15%-20%) Qualifications & Requirements Medical Degree from an accredited and internationally recognized medical school with a curriculum relevant to general medical education, along with a medical license, or equivalent, from the country or region in which he/she resides and works is required, plus a minimum of 5 years' experience in clinical medicine, in addition to clinical trials experience as an investigator or in the Pharma, CRO, or Biotech industry. Robust and current knowledge of scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial and competitive landscape in applicable therapeutic area. Knowledge of applicable federal and local regulations and guidelines pertaining to clinical research. Business Acumen. Board Certified Experience or knowledge in Phase I studies or early clinical development. Fluent English. Extensive communication skills. IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism. At IQVIA, we believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging empower our mission to accelerate innovation for a healthier world. We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. When our talented employees bring their authentic selves and their diverse experiences to work, they enable us to accomplish extraordinary things. Multifaceted thought processes spark innovation. Multi-talented collaboration harnesses innovation to deliver superior outcomes. Reto: Apoyar la gestión integral de Seguridad, Salud Ocupacional y Medio Ambiente (SSOMA) en planta, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad, la identificación y control de riesgos y el seguimiento oportuno de las condiciones que puedan generar accidentes, incidentes o impactos ambientales. Qué harás? Realizar inspecciones periódicas de seguridad en las diferentes áreas de planta, identificando actos y condiciones inseguras. Dar seguimiento al levantamiento y cierre de hallazgos y acciones correctivas derivados de inspecciones, incidentes y auditorías. Verificar el cumplimiento del uso adecuado de equipos de protección personal (EPP) según los riesgos de cada operación. Apoyar la identificación de peligros y evaluación de riesgos de las diferentes actividades y puestos de trabajo. Verificar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos de seguridad aplicables a las operaciones de planta y actividades de mantenimiento. Supervisar las condiciones de seguridad relacionadas con maquinaria, equipos, señalización, rutas de evacuación y áreas de trabajo .. Proponer mejoras que permitan reducir riesgos, prevenir accidentes y fortalecer la cultura de seguridad en las áreas operativas. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia de 1 año en posiciones de Seguridad Industrial, Salud Ocupacional, SSOMA o similares, preferiblemente en empresas de manufactura o plantas industriales. Conocimiento de identificación de peligros, evaluación de riesgos, inspecciones de seguridad e investigación de accidentes. Conocimiento en manejo y control de EPP, equipos de emergencia y procedimientos de seguridad industrial. Manejo de Excel y herramientas para elaboración de reportes e indicadores. Capacidad para trabajar directamente con personal operativo y realizar recorridos frecuentes en planta. Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en nuestra planta en Villa Nueva , de lunes a sábado. Beneficios: Alimentación y parqueo cubierto por la empresa. Participación directa en proyectos de mejora de seguridad, prevención de accidentes y condiciones de trabajo . Desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa multilatina con más de 20 años de experiencia en la industria de empaques flexibles.

review_candidates.description: Kun jij razendsnel puzzelen en relevante informatie vinden in onze politiesystemen en open bronnen? Als medewerker bij het Real Time Intelligence Center (RTIC) is het jouw doel om de collega’s op straat en in de opsporing te voorzien van intelligence. Zo draag jij direct bij aan de veiligheid. Wat ga je doen? Je gaat als generalist intelligence werken op de meldkamer. Daar komen 24/7 meldingen binnen voor alle hulpdiensten. Meldingen die meer aandacht nodig hebben pak jij op. Je ondersteunt de senior en de officier van dienst intelligence bij deze meldingen. Je gebruikt diverse systemen, data en eigen kennis om tot verschillende stukken informatie te komen deze te duiden en hier intelligence van te maken. Daarbij maak je onderscheid tussen hoofd- en bijzaken zodat alleen het essentiële wordt gedeeld. Je werkt in meerdere politiesystemen en -bronnen tegelijk, dit zijn applicaties die zowel audio, visueel en tekstueel verwerkt worden. Daarnaast maak je gebruik van open source intelligence (OSINT), denk hierbij aan bijvoorbeeld “X”, Instagram en Snapchat. Maar ook het onderdeel Sensing krijgt een steeds grotere rol denk hierbij aan ANPR camera’s maar ook aan (camera)beelden van bijvoorbeeld een politiehelikopter of drone. Een voorbeeld van een melding is een schietpartij waarbij je gaat zoeken in de systemen om te kijken of je informatie kunt vinden over de betrokkene(n), wat een mogelijk scenario zou kunnen zijn en/of er informatie over een netwerk bekend is. Foto’s en/of filmpjes van sociale media kunnen wellicht informatie geven over de actuele situatie. Maar ook aan de hand van summiere informatie, denk aan een deel van een kenteken en/of signalement van de verdachte(n), veredel je de melding en draag je hierdoor actief bij aan de veiligheid. Dit vergt een nieuwsgierige blik en een creatieve geest om zonder handleiding de puzzel toch op te lossen. Bij het grote deel van deze incidenten speelt tijdsdruk een grote rol. Naast het werken op de meldkamer en het behandelen van incidenten, ondersteun je ook bij grootschalige politieoptredens en evenementen in verschillende rollen. Je werkt in wisselende diensten (vroeg, laat- en nacht). Waar ga je werken? Je komt te werken op de meldkamer van Haarlem voor de politie-eenheid Noord-Holland. De combinatie van inkomende 112 meldingen, veel collega’s op de werkvloer en onvoorziene piekmomenten in het werkaanbod maken jouw werk en -omgeving dynamisch. Het Real Time Intelligence Center is onderdeel van de Dienst Regionale Intelligence Organisatie (DRIO). Het RTIC is een team waar veel collegialiteit heerst. Het betreft een divers team met verschillende (werk technische-) achtergronden en persoonlijkheden. Met elkaar praten de collega’s over de impact van meldingen en ook humor speelt een grote rol binnen dit team. Ontwikkelen en innoveren vinden we belangrijk! Wie ben jij? Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt maatschappelijke oriëntatie hoog in het vaandel staan. Hoofd- en bijzaken kun je prima onderscheiden, en legt patronen en verbanden vast. Je werkt toe naar duiding, voorspelling en advisering in real time situaties. Je stelt prioriteiten en kunt snel schakelen. Je voelt je thuis in het werken met computersystemen en daardoor kun je ook snel zoeken en filteren. Elke melding vraagt een eigen aanpak en je vraagt door wanneer jij dat nodig vindt. Je geeft een goede context aan de woorden die je gevonden hebt. Er zit namelijk een verschil tussen ‘iemand is gewelddadig’ en ‘iemand is mogelijk gewelddadig’. Het geeft je energie om in een dynamische omgeving met veel geluiden en bewegingen een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan het oplossen en afhandelen van de melding. Verder vragen wij een havo of vwo diploma, of je beschikt over mbo 3 werk- en denkniveau*; Wat wij bieden De standplaats is Haarlem. Er is ruimte voor 1 fte. Het betreft een functie voor minimaal 32 uur per week. Afhankelijk van je achtergrond volg je aan de Politieacademie een 14-weekse opleiding voor specifieke inzetbaarheid (36 uur per week), met eventueel aansluitend een voor de functie benodigd aanvullend opleidingsprogramma. Tijdens deze opleiding(en) ontvang je al het met jou overeengekomen salaris. Het positief afronden van het verplichte assessment is voorwaarde om aan de opleiding te kunnen beginnen. Het behalen van de opleiding is een vereiste om deze functie uit te kunnen oefenen. Hier vind je alle informatie met betrekking tot de selectieprocedure, het assessment en de opleiding. Tijdens de interne specifieke politieopleiding word je tijdelijk aangesteld als ambtenaar in opleiding. Na het voltooien van de opleiding bieden we je een tijdelijke aanstelling aan, waarbij een proeftijd van één jaar van toepassing is. Na deze proeftijd volgt zo snel mogelijk een vaste aanstelling. Binnen de politie investeren we in jouw toekomst. We bieden uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een aantrekkelijk pakket arbeidsvoorwaarden. Denk hierbij aan een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 2.695,- en maximaal € 4.330,- (schaal 7 Bbp) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek; een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) dat uit twee delen bestaat Een bruto deel van 17,86% van je salaris. Met dit budget kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het uitbetalen van je budget, het kopen van vakantie-uren of ontwikkelactiviteiten zoals een opleiding. Een netto deel van € 515,91 per jaar. Dit budget kun je bijvoorbeeld gebruiken voor duurzaamheidsdoelen, vakbondscontributie en voor vitaliteit. een uitstekende pensioenopbouw bij ABP en betaald ouderschapsverlof ( meer info over verlof, regelingen en mogelijkheden ). De formele functie binnen het functiegebouw van de politie is generalist intelligence . Interesse? Bel of mail met Niels van Breemen, operationeel specialist B RTIC, (06 - 20 40 03 19, niels,van.breemen@politie.nl ) of Alied Ottens, operationeel expert RTIC (06 - 18 63 08 23, alied.ottens@politie.nl ) als je meer informatie over de functie wilt hebben. Voor meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure bel of mail je met Laura Verhoeven-Kinds, recruiter (06 - 18 18 46 12, laura.verhoeven-kinds@politie.nl ) Solliciteer uiterlijk 4 oktober 2026 via de sollicitatiebutton. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wat verder belangrijk is Een betrouwbaarheids- en omgevingsonderzoek maakt deel uit van de selectieprocedure. Een vakinhoudelijk assessment maakt mogelijk deel uit van de selectieprocedure. De kennismakingsgesprekken staan gepland in week 27. Je hebt de Nederlandse nationaliteit (dit mag ook je 2e nationaliteit zijn). De politie werkt in een veranderende samenleving waarin uiteenlopende perspectieven essentieel zijn voor goed politiewerk. Daarom is diversiteit voor ons van groot belang. Hoe kunnen we jouw kennis en achtergrond hiervoor inzetten? Je hebt een diploma op mbo 3-niveau of je bent daaraan gelijkgesteld via EVC. Of je hebt minimaal twee jaar werkervaring op het gevraagde niveau. Dit toon je aan met een erkende functieomschrijving of een formeel vastgestelde vacaturetekst of een ander formeel bewijsstuk. Het bewijsstuk heeft aantoonbaar betrekking op een functie die je daadwerkelijk hebt uitgevoerd en moet herleidbaar zijn tot jouw persoon. Denk aan een werkgeversverklaring waarin het werk- en denkniveau staat opgenomen of een uittreksel uit het HR-systeem waarop je functie en het dienstverband zichtbaar zijn.

review_candidates.title: Visitor Experience Producer and Programmer
review_candidates.description: Heritage is for everybody, and we are here for heritage.Heritage lives in places and people, memories and stories, artefacts and traditions. It can connect us all to the past, and to each other. It can make us happier, strengthen every community, and help shape society for the better. Everybody should be able to enjoy the benefits it brings.That's why, as a charity, we care for over a million objects and hundreds of historic sites in every part of England, from international icons to local treasures. And it's why we open them up, share their stories and find new ways for everybody to enjoy, learn, play and create.We are looking for a Visitor Experience Producer and Programmer to join our team. The role is full time and permanent working 36 hours per week.We offer flexible working arrangements where the role allows. Due to the operational demands of the role, candidates will ideally be based in either the Midlands, London, South East or East of England. You can be based in one of our regional office locations (Bristol, Swindon, London) or one of our site based offices (Dover Castle, Wrest Park) or be a homeworker. As a national role some travel will be needed.The Benefits- Salary from £39,855, depending on skills, experience and location- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, pro rata, rising to 28 days after 3 years- Matched pension contributions up to 10%- Flexible hours- The opportunity to progress your career within the heritage sector- Apprenticeship opportunities- Subscriptions to professional bodies- Free access to all English Heritage sites for you and up to six friends and family members- 25% discount in our shops and cafes- Enhanced maternity, paternity or shared parental leave- Options to buy additional leave- An inclusive working atmosphere everybody is supported from all backgrounds, religions and with different needs- Opportunities to go to some of our great live music and history eventsWe're looking for a creative, audience-focused Visitor Experience Producer and Programmer to help develop and deliver an inspiring programme of events and activities across our estate.As a key member of the Visitor Experience & Engagement team, you will work closely with the National Event and Venue Hire Programme Lead to shape our national visitor offer. Combining strategic planning with creative production, you'll develop engaging experiences that attract new audiences, encourage repeat visits and enhance the visitor experience across our historic properties. Using visitor insight, feedback and industry best practice, you will help ensure our programme remains relevant, memorable and appealing to a diverse range of audiences.You will oversee the planning and coordination of a varied annual programme across our historic properties, ensuring activities are deliverable, commercially viable and consistently high quality. The role also involves championing inclusion and innovation by testing new formats, identifying emerging trends and partnership opportunities, and supporting site teams through the development of resources and guidance. Alongside maintaining a national events calendar, you will contribute to the successful delivery of events on site and drive continuous improvement in the visitor experience.This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about creating memorable experiences and wants to make a lasting impact on how people connect with England's heritage.We're looking for an imaginative and audience-focused producer and programmer who is passionate about developing experiences that bring heritage to life. You will be equally comfortable generating innovative ideas and turning them into practical, high-quality events and activities that engage visitors, support commercial objectives and enhance the reputation of English Heritage.A natural collaborator, you will enjoy working with a wide range of colleagues, partners and stakeholders to shape and deliver compelling visitor experiences. You'll combine creativity with strong organisational skills, using audience insight, feedback and emerging trends to continuously improve and evolve our visitor offer. Most importantly, you'll share our commitment to making heritage relevant, inclusive and accessible to everyone.To be considered for the role, you'll need:-Experience in creative production, programming or event planning, ideally within a heritage, cultural, tourism or visitor attraction environment.-A track record of developing and delivering engaging events, activities or experiences for diverse audiences.-Strong creative and conceptual thinking, with the ability to turn ideas into deliverable, high-quality visitor experiences.-An understanding of audience insight and how to use data, trends and feedback to shape successful programmes.-Excellent relationship-building skills and experience working collaboratively across multiple teams and stakeholders.-Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities.-Confident communication and influencing skills.-Able to work effectively within a complex or matrixed organisation.-A passion for creating memorable visitor experiences and inspiring people to connect with England's heritage.Interviews will be held on 24th and 25th September on MS Teams.If you would like to talk to us e.g. about workplace adjustments or working patterns, please contact Beth Stone, Head of Visitor Experience and Engagement, on beth.stone@english-heritage.org.uk. No agencies please.Find out more about us and what we do: https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/about/ You can also meet some of our people and hear about why they enjoy working with us: https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/about/our-people/careers-with-us/Everybody's welcome at English HeritageForget the stereotypes. It takes thousands of people from every background to care for England's heritage and open it up for everybody to enjoy. We're looking for every type of person with every kind of skill and experience, and we're committed to making sure that English Heritage is an equitable, diverse and inclusive place to work. You can connect with others through our EDI networks as a member or ally. These include Ethnic Diversity, Faith & Belief, Social Equity, LGBTQ+, Neurodivergence, Age, Disability and Gender Health and Wellbeing.We take wellbeing seriously. We are committed to ensuring everyone feels safe at work and can carry out their role. To support this, we have a network of Mental Health First aiders, regular information and awareness events, unlimited access to an Employee Assistance Programme and work with our people to implement reasonable adjustments. review_candidates.title: QA Engineer (Senior)
review_candidates.description: Description About Xe Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas. Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale. About This Role We're hiring a senior QA engineer who owns quality end-to-end and shapes how the team tests, from test design and automation infrastructure through to release gating and production observability. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship. You'll catch problems before code that moves money hits production, design the test automation other engineers depend on, and lead modernization of the test estate as new capability ships. You'll work in a small team with direct access to engineering, product, and compliance, own quality strategy for your domain, lead test architecture decisions, mentor mid-level QA engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain quality decisions. What You'll Do Design and own integration test harnesses and contract tests for the flows that move money, across a range of domains and the partner APIs behind them. Lead the design of the test automation that gates code into production, across onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting flows. Set the balance of manual and automated testing for your domain: write test cases, run manual tests where they are the right tool, and lead automation in Playwright and equivalent frameworks. Own CI/CD quality strategy for your domain (release-blocking signals, flaky-test triage, test infrastructure health), lead production incident investigation, and translate findings into automated tests and process improvements. Lead design reviews of test architecture, set quality direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level QA engineers. Use agentic coding tools and AI test tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent; test generation, eval frameworks, or equivalent) daily, and lead the build of the test estate for new capability on the modern stack. What We're Looking For Must-have 6 to 10+ years building production test automation, end-to-end. Strong test automation skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or C#, including test framework design, system design, and test architecture experience. SQL and relational database fundamentals (for test data, validation, and debugging). API testing (Postman, Bruno, or equivalent) and UI automation (Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent). Functional and non-functional testing principles (reliability and security) and disciplined defect management, with hands-on performance, load, or resilience testing (k6, JMeter, or equivalent). Comfortable generating test cases and running manual tests where they are the right tool, alongside building automated coverage. Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) and AI test tools (test generation, eval frameworks, or equivalent) across the SDLC. Production experience with AWS in a development or test context, and CI/CD pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions or equivalent), including building release gates. Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience. Track record of QA technical leadership: setting test architecture, leading code reviews of test automation, and making quality decisions in your domain. Strong written and verbal communication. Nice-to-have Experience with contract testing for partner integrations (Pact or equivalent). Experience testing Windows client applications. Mobile app test automation. Experience leading modernization of test estates or quality programs. Perks & Benefits Competitive Salary & Discretionary Bonus 23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days) Paid day off for your Birthday 4% employer pension contribution Discounted Euronet ESPP Life Cover, Income Protection & Critical Illness cover Healthcare Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing Volunteering day for a charity of your choice We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects. Xe is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com. review_candidates.title: Project Planner / PMO
review_candidates.description: Position Description Join CGI as a Project Planner and play a pivotal role in shaping the successful delivery of a high-profile programme in Aberdeen. You'll take ownership of developing a robust, credible programme schedule that gives senior stakeholders the insight and confidence to make critical delivery decisions. Using your expertise in Microsoft Project, you'll challenge assumptions, validate the critical path and explore schedule and resource scenarios to strengthen programme commitments. This is an opportunity to bring fresh thinking to complex planning challenges while working closely with the Programme Manager, workstream leads and a supportive community of CGI professionals, where your expertise will directly influence programme outcomes and help establish a strong foundation for successful delivery. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK 'Best Employer' by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you'll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We'll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. This role is based in Aberdeen and requires a minimum of three days per week on site. Your future duties and responsibilities In this highly visible role, you will take ownership of developing, consolidating and maintaining an integrated programme-level schedule using Microsoft Project. Your immediate focus will be establishing and validating a credible baseline that supports programme decision-making and senior management commitments. You'll analyse schedule logic, dependencies, milestones and assumptions, using critical-path analysis and scenario testing to identify potential risks before they affect delivery. Working closely with the Programme Manager, project managers, workstream leads and wider stakeholders, you'll bring structure and insight to significant volumes of planning information. You'll be encouraged to challenge assumptions, explore alternative scenarios and recommend practical solutions, with support from colleagues across the programme to turn complex schedule data into clear, actionable delivery insight. Develop & Integrate: Build, consolidate and maintain the programme-level schedule using Microsoft Project. Baseline & Assure: Lead planning activity supporting the development of a robust and credible programme schedule baseline. Analyse & Validate: Review schedule logic, milestones, dependencies and assumptions to identify gaps and inconsistencies. Assess & Challenge: Perform critical-path analysis to identify activities and constraints that could affect key milestones. Stress Test & Forecast: Model schedule risks and potential delivery scenarios to understand their impact on programme commitments. Plan & Optimise: Assess resource availability and capacity against the schedule, highlighting bottlenecks and potential delivery impacts. Collaborate & Coordinate: Work with programme stakeholders to capture, challenge and validate planning information. Inform & Influence: Translate complex scheduling information into clear insights that support senior-level decisions and commitments. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You'll bring strong programme or project planning experience, with advanced practical knowledge of Microsoft Project and the ability to develop and interrogate complex integrated schedules. At least 5 years of experience leading technical teams to meet strict business deadlines with high-quality deliverables. At least 5 years of experience in control and protection algorithm development using MATLAB/Simulink and conducting EMT (Electromagnetic Transient) studies. Deep technical understanding of Line Commutated Converter (LCC) technology, including: Firing angle (Alpha) control and synchronization logic. Commutation failure prediction and mitigation.
